IPT.evidence_source: [/page/4/Text/7] PTA focuses on cognitivebehavioral factors such as the youth's coping and cognitive style and problem-solving, with application of skills to broader areas including school functioning, interpersonal relations, and health behavior

dxgive.evidence_source: [/page/4/Text/7] PTA—Positive Thoughts and Actions (PTA) is a manualized, developmentally-based prevention program designed to address key factors that contribute to and perpetuate depressive symptoms during the early adolescent years.

Source.evidence_source: [/page/4/Text/7] At week 11 of the groups, students rated their satisfaction and comfort with the PTA class using a modified version of the Working Alliance Inventory (Horvath & Greenberg, 1989). Following each home visit and parent workshop, parents rated how helpful the content of the session was.
